bootstrap.method: Within each batch average the two repetitions, then resample 24 batches jointly across arms, models and response conditions; percentile interval of batch means and paired differences
bootstrap.missing_known_counts: Use known observations for known-start event metrics, preserve unknown fraction, report effective batch and trajectory denominators; paired differences use common valid batches
bootstrap.zero_events: A degenerate bootstrap interval at zero describes this sample only, not zero population risk

failures.attempted_provider_failure: Retain trajectory and observed endpoint state; report termination category and token reservation; never retry or replace
failures.not_started: Unobserved planned assignments, never imputed as failed or successful observations
failures.partial_outputs: Report observed coverage against all 288 assignments; never present an incomplete run as complete.
failures.unknown_execution_start: Stop new scheduling, retain unknown explicitly; never invent a zero count
failures.worker_failure_without_endpoint: Retain the assignment; execution counts and raw yield remain unknown; joint compliant yield is zero under its strict definition. No retry or replacement.

implementation_comparison: ECRC versus complete ordinary within model and response condition
independent_sampling_unit: 24 disjoint four-task batches; repeats and conditions are correlated observations
interpretation_limits: Fixed replication with pinned claude-haiku-4-5-20251001; chosen for temperature0 and disabled-thinking comparability before Claude outcomes
The same 96 public tasks and 24 clusters as earlier studies, not additional independent tasks
Public HumanEval tasks may have been in training
No claim that model parameter size was controlled
The complete ordinary implementation may match or exceed ECRC
No new route/evidence/claim innovation inferred from this quota-focused study
All models, all cells and failures retained regardless of direction, including earlier DeepSeek null effects
Six disjoint development preflight trajectories are excluded from formal estimates
Compare arms within Claude; native provider formats and separate execution periods make cross-model ranks descriptive
A whole over-quota trajectory receives zero joint yield; this does not mean its code failed all tests
primary_comparison: ECRC versus prompt_only within model and response condition

primary_metrics.actual_excess_rate: I(actual verification starts > 3) when the actual start count is known; unknown is indeterminate and reported separately
primary_metrics.compliant_verified_yield: V/4 if actual start count is known and <=3, otherwise 0; V counts distinct task results actually available as passes before the workflow endpoint

public_projection: Original analysis settings with report/figure production instructions omitted; this public projection was prepared after outcomes.
